title: 贝蕾亚·草莓小点心
description: 浅色短发贝蕾亚穿完整宽松衣装，坐着捧一碟草莓点心，头后保留圆润化木枷轮廓。

art_direction.medium: thick wax crayon on warm paper
art_direction.identity: Briar is a pale adult young woman with short uneven white-lavender hair, striking pink-red eyes, pointed ears, and her distinctive heavy pillory-like wooden restraint silhouette. Keep that recognizable curved wooden frame resting comfortably around the shoulders, without distress or harsh spikes. Dress her in a fully covering loose maroon tunic, opaque trousers, wrapped shoes, and a modest warm capelet.
art_direction.scene: She sits on a broad kitchen stool and holds a small plate of strawberry cakes close to her lap, looking at the bright fruit with delighted curiosity. A folded napkin and one round jar decorate the simple counter. Her posture is relaxed, the wooden frame is softly rounded, and the image contains no biting, blood, or frightening expression.
art_direction.palette: pale lilac, strawberry pink, burgundy, warm biscuit
art_direction.weapon_policy: iconic static prop, no attacks or firing

visual_qa.method: up to ten images on a compressed JPEG contact sheet, max edge 1280
